This Master Services Agreement takes effect on 13 August 2025 (the "Effective Date"). It is between Northwind Labs, Inc. ("Northwind") and Juniper Cloud Services, Inc. ("Juniper"). Each is a "Party" and together they are the "Parties".

## 1. Why are the Parties entering into this Agreement?
Juniper will provide professional services to Northwind. It will do so under one or more Statements of Work.

## 2. How long does this Agreement last?
This Agreement starts on the Effective Date. It runs for 6 months. The Parties can extend it only by mutual written agreement.

## 3. What happens if there is a dispute?
The Parties must first try in good faith to settle any dispute. Their senior executives must discuss it. If the dispute is still unresolved after twenty Business Days, either Party may pursue the remedies open to it.

## 4. Can this Agreement be signed in counterparts?
Yes. The Parties may sign in counterparts. They may also sign electronically.

## 5. Can the Parties hire each other's people?
During the term and for twelve months afterwards, neither Party may knowingly solicit for employment any of the other Party's Personnel. This applies to Personnel who were directly involved in carrying out this Agreement. General advertisements do not breach this clause.

## 6. What do the Parties confirm about themselves?
Each Party confirms that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement. Juniper also confirms that its personnel are suitably qualified.

## 7. What if something outside a Party's control causes delay?
Neither Party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control.

## 8. Can a Party check the other's records?
Yes, but only to verify compliance with this Agreement. The Party wanting to audit must give reasonable prior notice. It may audit no more than once per year. Audits must take place in normal business hours. They must not unreasonably interfere with operations.

## 9. Which law applies?
The laws of Ontario govern this Agreement and decide how it is interpreted. Ontario's conflict of laws principles do not apply.

## 10. What standard of work does each Party promise?
Each Party warrants that it will:
- perform its obligations in a professional and workmanlike manner;
- follow generally recognised industry standards; and
- comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET OUT IN THIS AGREEMENT, NEITHER PARTY GIVES ANY OTHER WARRANTY, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED. THIS INCLUDES ANY WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

## 11. When must Northwind pay?
Northwind must pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receiving them.

## 12. How are notices given?
All notices must be in writing. They must be delivered to the addresses set out below. Notices to Northwind must be sent to dana@northwind.example.

## 13. How much can each Party be liable for?
Each Party's total cumulative liability under this Agreement must not exceed $1,000,000.

## 14. What insurance must each Party hold?
Each Party must maintain commercial general liability and professional insurance at its own cost. The insurance must be with reputable insurers. The amounts must be customary for its industry. On reasonable request, each Party must provide certificates of insurance.

## 15. Can a Party transfer this Agreement?
Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the other Party's prior written consent. The exception is an assignment to a successor in a merger or in a sale of substantially all of its assets.

## 16. Who covers third-party claims?
Juniper must indemnify and hold harmless Northwind from third-party claims arising from the Services.

## 17. Where are the fees set out?
The fees for the Services are set out in each Statement of Work.

## 18. What do the key terms mean?
- "Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls a Party, is controlled by a Party, or is under common control with a Party.
- "Business Day" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday.
- "Personnel" means a Party's employees, officers and permitted subcontractors.

Headings are for ease of reference only. They do not affect interpretation.
